title: Extending Quotients of Knot Groups over Surfaces in $B^4$
summary: Let $K\subseteq S^3$ be a knot with exterior $E_K$, and denote by $ρ\colon π_1(E_K)\twoheadrightarrow G$ a quotient of its group. We give a sharp obstruction to the existence of a connected, oriented, smooth surface $F\subseteq B^4$ with $\partial F = K$ over whose exterior $ρ$ extends surjectively. Equivalently, we determine whether the cover of $S^3$ branched over $K$ and induced by $ρ$ bounds a connected cover of $B^4$ branched along such a surface.
